title: A failed download shows the format-specific error notification, verbatim
permissions_required: A role with the existing inventory-reports permission (Story 1 prerequisite).
preconditions: 1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. A download failure can be simulated (for example, disconnect the network just before requesting the download).
steps: 1. Simulate a failure and request the PDF download; read the notification.
expected: 1. The failed PDF download shows an error notification: "Failed to export inventory value report (pdf)".
2. The failed CSV download shows an error notification: "Failed to export inventory value report (csv)".
design_ref: none — design not yet available (spec-only authoring)
spec_ref: specs/inventory-value.md Story 10 S10-R14; §7 User Feedback Summary
notes: Notification texts are verbatim from the spec (note the lower-case "(pdf)"/"(csv)" in the failure messages vs the upper-case success ones).
